title: Search, filter and price with a publishable key (curl)
caption: Customer scope through X-Api-Key pk_test_… (no Origin header needed from curl; a browser must be on the key's origin allow-list). Against the Amadeus stub, Madrid → Paris returns five offers; destination ZZZ returns none.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: `curl -s -X POST localhost:4000/v1/flight-searches -H 'X-Api-Key: pk_test_…' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"mode":"simple","originLocationCode":"MAD","destinationLocationCode":"PAR","departureDate":"<a date 30 days ahead>","adults":1}'`
steps.expect: `201` with `srch_…`, `status: completed`, `resultCount` 5 (stub). Rows: `tenant_demo.flight_searches` + 5 `flight_offers` (net, markup, selling), one `supplier_requests` row (FlightOffersSearch, success).

steps.title: List and filter
steps.expect: `200` with offers sorted by price; only selling amounts (no `net*`, `markup*`, `margin*` keys in customer scope). No new `supplier_requests` row.

steps.title: Offer detail and upsell
steps.expect: Upsell `200` with fare families (stub: BASIC, CLASSIC, FLEXIBLE) stored as `flight_offers` with `origin = 'upsell'`; the same request again answers `cached: true` without a new Amadeus call.

steps.title: Price
steps.expect: `201` `prc_…` with `selling_total = net + markup + fees`, `priceChanged` false (send `X-Stub-Scenario: price-changed` to see true with old and new totals). Row in `priced_offers`.

steps.title: Expiry
steps.body: Wait past the search's `expires_at` (or test with an old search id), then list again.
steps.expect: `GET /v1/flight-searches/{id}/offers` → `410 SEARCH_EXPIRED`; `GET /v1/flight-searches/{id}` still `200` with `status: expired`; `offers.purge` (every 15 min) later deletes the expired search unless a checkout references its priced offer.

steps.title: Edge cases
steps.body: Destination `ZZZ`; 31 searches within a minute from one IP; Amadeus stub stopped.
steps.expect: Zero offers with `201`; `429 RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`; `503 SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE` / `504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT` and the search row `failed`.
